projects.name: denpa
projects.description: A home TV recording server that works right away just by inserting a tuner and starting it up, without writing a single line of configuration file. The tuner automatically identifies the type (PX-Q3U4 and the like don't even need drivers on the host), and then it's just pressing scan on the screen. There's no need to set up Mirakurun or EDCB separately and connect them, and yet everything you want to change can be modified from the screen. Commercials are skipped automatically, and you can watch both live broadcasts and recordings in the browser with subtitles and data broadcasting.
projects.originalDescription: チューナーを挿して起動すれば、設定ファイルを1行も書かずに使える自宅用テレビ録画サーバ。チューナーは種別まで自動で判別し (PX-Q3U4 などはホストにドライバすら不要)、あとは画面でスキャンを押すだけ。Mirakurun や EDCB を別に立てて繋ぐ必要はなく、それでいて直したいところは全部画面から変えられる。CM は自動で飛ばし、字幕・データ放送つきでライブも録画もブラウザで観られる。
